label: Claude with feature-dev
install: set -e; curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash; claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-official; claude plugin install feature-dev@claude-plugins-official
run: { printf '/feature-dev '; cat "$SWE_PROMPT"; printf '\nWork without asking questions: no one will answer. At each point where the workflow asks for a choice or an approval, take the recommended choice and go on to the end.\n'; } | claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --permission-mode bypassPermissions ${SWE_MODEL:+--model "$SWE_MODEL"} ${SWE_EFFORT:+--effort "$SWE_EFFORT"}
fired: any(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init" and ((.slash_commands // []) | any(tostring | test("feature-dev")))) and any(.type == "result" and (.is_error | not))
